sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.

AI natively supports all 15 field types (text, email, phone with +91 validation, number, textarea, select dropdown, radio, checkbox, date, time slot, slider with min/max/step, rating, file upload dropzone, digital signature pad, and GST tax calculator). Drivers only see their active van consignment, stock on wheels, spot sales, and cash collections.

All platform administration, factory-level stock, and workspace management discussions are strictly blocked.

  • Direct Invite Link & Multi-Channel Share Suite: Added 1-tap Copy Direct Invite Link, WhatsApp Share with pre-formatted dispatch brief, and Re-send Email triggers directly on consignment cards.
  • Strict Driver-Scoped Field Sales Navigation: Restricts cora_field_vendor driver accounts exclusively to their assigned Van Sales & Route POS terminal, locking out central plant management, settings, financial overviews, and CRM features.

v4.9.96

Added fallback jQuery / DOM-ready initialization to guarantee 100% click responsiveness across all buttons (+ Add SKU, Dispatch Van, Import, Export, Adjust, Delete, Subtabs).

  • Full UI Clickability & Mobile Responsive Polish: Eliminated trailing template characters and verified 100% clean DOM hierarchy and click event delegation across all workspace devices and operating systems.

v4.9.94

Aligned modal DOM selectors and verified clean JavaScript execution across all workspace modules.

v4.9.93

  • Overhauled Dispatch Van Consignment Mobile Drawer: Upgraded the field van consignment workflow into an uncluttered, intuitive 3-card architecture (Driver & Vehicle, Territory & Route with 1-tap quick city chips, Product Allocation Suite) with elevated z-[99999] layer and a sticky bottom footer (padding-bottom: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))) ensuring Cancel and Dispatch CTAs remain 100% visible and unobstructed above the mobile navigation island.

Added a 1-tap Share Drawer for instant WhatsApp report sharing, executive briefing text copy, and printable PDF links.

v4.9.86

  • Editable & Deletable Spot Invoices (Sales Entries): Made all spot billing invoices in Field Van Sales editable and deletable. Added Edit (pencil) and Delete (trash) action buttons on each invoice card with dedicated Studio Drawers. Updating an invoice recalculates consignment totals and payment statuses; deleting an invoice safely restores sold item quantities back to active van stock and decrements consignment collection financials.
  • Editable & Deletable Van Consignments: Consignment records in Plant Inventory can now be edited (updating vehicle number, territory route, Google Maps navigation links, and target coverage cities) or deleted (automatically restocking unsold allocated items back to Factory Catalog stock).
  • Monochromatic Zero-Browser-Confirm Architecture: All deletion and update actions use dedicated sliding Studio Drawers and monochromatic bottom sheets without invoking browser-native confirm() dialogs.

v4.9.85

  • Purged Dollar Sign Icons Across Inventory Views: Removed the dollar sign icon prefix from the Quick Spot Sale action button in the header and field terminal navigation, aligning it with the clean plus vector icon (+ Quick Spot Sale). Replaced remaining dollar SVGs in KPI telemetry and drawer headers with crisp receipt and shopping bag vector iconography.

v4.9.84

  • Top 5 Pre-Selected Allocation & Live SKU Catalog Search: Overhauled Van Consignment dispatch with an intelligent Top 5 pre-selected product allocation system initialized with positive stock and quantity >= 1. Added a high-speed instant search dropdown to seamlessly locate and allocate any SKU from catalog items with visual thumbnails, prices, and stock indicators.
  • Mandatory Driver Credentials & Zero-Unit Prevention: Enforced strict validation requiring both driver email address and mobile phone number upon driver creation. Enforced absolute zero-unit prevention where every allocated item must have a quantity of 1 or more units.
  • Multi-City Target Coverage & Google Maps Route Integration: Added route links with Google Maps integration and multi-city target coverage selection with 1-tap quick preset city chips (Delhi NCR, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore). Scoped mobile vendor terminal to display active route telemetry and direct 1-tap Google Maps navigation.

v4.9.83

Made Import / Kits and Export buttons permanently visible across all screen sizes and resolutions in the header bar and embedded them directly in the Central Plant Catalog table toolbar for instant 1-click access.

v4.9.82

  • Context-Aware Action Bar & Uncluttered Perspective Switcher: Streamlined the Inventory Management top action bar into two isolated, context-aware command suites. In Plant Inventory mode, displays strictly central factory tools (+ Add SKU, Dispatch Van, Import / Kits, Export). In Field Van Sales mode, displays exclusively mobile field tools (+ Quick Spot Sale, AI Bill Scanner), eliminating CTA clutter and wrapping across desktop and mobile screens.
  • Van Dispatch Integrated with User Directory & Role-Scoped Invitations: Transformed Van Dispatch driver allocation into a dual-mode engine connected to the workspace team directory. Dispatchers can select an existing team member or seamlessly invite a new field driver on the fly with auto-assigned role cora_field_vendor (Field Sales / Mobile Vendor), tenant agency scoping, and instant activation email dispatch via cora_invitations.

v4.9.81

Added smooth requestAnimationFrame entrance animations and eliminated ghost overlay pointer interception, restoring 100% responsiveness to all header CTAs and mode switchers.

v4.9.79

  • Smart Toast Placement & Dynamic CTA Collision Avoidance: Upgraded toast notifications to automatically detect active full-height/bottom sheets, open modal drawers, and bottom-right interactive CTA buttons. Dynamically offsets toast container elevation (88px+ from bottom, 36px inset) to ensure primary action buttons (Save SKU, Next Step, Submit) remain 100% visible, clickable, and unobstructed.

v4.9.78

  • Product Image & Media Upload Multi-Key Fix: Fixed product photo upload in the Stationery SKU Creator by handling both image and image_file multi-part FormData keys on the server and client. Reset file inputs on upload completion and restored instant media attachment preview.

v4.9.77

  • Zero Header Overlap Full-Height SKU Workspace: Positioned the Add/Edit Product full-height workspace dynamically immediately below the platform header (#cora-global-topbar), ensuring the topbar remains 100% visible and accessible while the drawer header and 3-step form span seamlessly to the bottom of the viewport with zero blur gap or top occlusion.

v4.9.76

Features an edge-to-edge header bar, full-height form body with generous vertical scrolling runway, and 1-tap top-right close and bottom cancel navigation.
